prefix: Reuse original stationary Hiring→Turnover generator through June2026; both branches preserve every pre-July truth value, release revision and availability timestamp. Model inputs are only the identical June30-visible aggregate releases.

shock.eligibleStock: Branch stock after each day's original scheduled starts, voluntary exits and other exits; draw extra voluntary exits binomially from remaining nonnegative stock.
shock.ordinaryFlows: Keep original company scheduled flows fixed; recompute shock branch stocks and person-days. Assert feasibility without clipping or rerolling.
shock.interpretation: Borrowed .007 parameter value, not a reconstruction of the prior reversal or an identified causal effect. Extra events can change later group allocations under the existing partition algorithm.

assignment.rule: One domain-separated Bernoulli draw per seed chooses the realized company continuation, independent by design of the prefix and both potential outcomes. No balancing, outcome-dependent draw or reroll.
assignment.caveat: Reproducible pseudo-random stream separation implements the design; it is not an empirical proof or cryptographic guarantee of independence.

forecast.calibration: Unchanged original eleven-quarter count-range procedure from group-turnover/evaluation.mjs; no refitting of method choices, adaptive rule or parameter tuning.
forecast.inputBoundary: No branch, assignment, seed, truth or shock schedule enters forecastGroup; wrapper family metadata remains stationary for both branches.

evaluation.unit: 100 paired histories per group; two potential outcomes are not200 independent histories. Groups share the company assignment.
evaluation.branches: Report both conditional branch metrics, one realized Bernoulli-assigned mixture and a prespecified50/50 design-weighted mixture.
evaluation.mixture: Average per-seed losses with branch weight0.5; RMSE=sqrt(weighted MSE), never mean of branch RMSEs. Preserve suppressed/missing denominators; report null if neither branch is scoreable.
evaluation.paired: Report differences of observed quarter totals and absolute count errors within each pair; simulation contrasts are not identified real-world causal effects.
evaluation.gate: No promotion or new qualification gate; all ranges are offline diagnostics. Original published gates remain unchanged.

privacy: Unchanged group partition, minimum headcount/positive-count and complementary suppression rules; assert daily stock/flow/exposure reconciliation.
reservedQuarter: October–December workforce data are not generated, retained, scored or used for selection in this control. Hiring follow-up after September is not a workforce outcome input.
custody: Freeze before any seed3001–3100 generation. No new model. Known synthetic assumptions and two potential continuations test implementation boundaries, not universal unpredictability or real accuracy.
failurePolicy: Report every seed and invariant failure; do not silently drop, widen, tune or regenerate favorable cases.
